name: Charred Tomato Galette
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a shallow tray with baking paper.
Soften the onion and garlic for six minutes, stirring so they do not colour.
Season generously, then stir through the remaining dry ingredients.
Transfer to the oven and roast until the edges catch and darken.
Rest for five minutes off the heat so the sauce thickens.
Taste, adjust the seasoning, and finish with a squeeze of lemon.
Scatter over the herbs and serve straight from the pan.

name: Chilled Walnut Hash
steps: Warm the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat until it shimmers.
Season generously, then stir through the remaining dry ingredients.
Pour in the stock, bring to a simmer, and cook uncovered for twenty minutes.
Rest for five minutes off the heat so the sauce thickens.
Taste, adjust the seasoning, and finish with a squeeze of lemon.
Scatter over the herbs and serve straight from the pan.
Cool completely before slicing, or the crumb will tear.
